definitions.gloss: while; as; in the process of
definitions.explanation: Indicates two actions happening simultaneously. Attaches to the verb stem (masu-form without masu).
Indicates a contradiction between what one knows or intends and what actually happens. Often used with も.

examples.japanese: ⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧つつ⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked while enjoying the scenery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧つつ、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れている→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: While preserving tradition, they are also incorporating new technology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Society is in the process of changing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思う：00492_omou⟧つつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{嘘|うそ}をついた→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧。
examples.english: Although I felt bad about it, I told a lie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧つつ、⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Even though I know it's not good for my health, I stay up late.

examples.japanese: ⟦ダイエットしなければ→ダイエットする：11008_daiettosuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思う：00492_omou⟧つつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、つい⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧もの⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Even though I think I need to diet, I can't help reaching for sweets.

notes:
A formal conjunctive particle that attaches to the verb stem (masu-form minus masu). It has two distinct uses: simultaneous actions (sense 1) and concessive/contradictory situations (sense 2).

USAGE:
- Attaches to verb stem: ⟦{読|よ}み→読む：00426_yomu⟧つつ, ⟦{考|かんが}え→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧つつ, ⟦{歩|ある}き→歩く：00538_aruku⟧つつ
- Sense 1 (simultaneous): more literary than ～⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ but similar meaning
- ～つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is a fixed pattern meaning "in the process of ~" (progressive change)
- Sense 2 (concessive): often paired with ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ → ～つつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (although, despite)
- More formal and literary than ～⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (sense 1) or ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (sense 2)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be in the process of changing
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思う：00492_omou⟧つつ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: although one thinks
- ⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧つつ: while knowing; despite knowing
- ⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧しつつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be decreasing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ～⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: while — more conversational; interchangeable with sense 1 in many cases
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: even though — more colloquial equivalent of sense 2
- ～にもかかわらず: despite, notwithstanding — very formal; stronger concessive meaning
- ～⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: while, on the other hand — presents contrasting situations
